surface: Vision-LLM chat answers parsed by auto_plan.vision
boundary: Plan/prompt assembly and lint in auto_plan.py

excluded_blocks.reason: no package manifest, lockfile, CI or release config in the repository
no HTTP server or auth protocol implemented in source
the LLM is given no tools; its answers are parsed as JSON only

local_checks.invariant: Vision-LLM JSON answers never reach a local executing sink (shell, file path, HTML, URL fetch) or grant authority
local_checks.result: vision() (tools/auto_plan.py:56-80) parses the substring between the first '{' and the last '}' with json.loads, so there is no code evaluation. 'hide' is accepted only if it is in the code-built hides list (line 262), and HIDES[hide] is indexed only with validated keys. Other answer fields are used only for strategy selection in choose() or for string formatting into the Kling prompt (TEMPLATE.format at line 277, where the LLM values are arguments, not the format string). The prompt goes only back to the KIE createTask API (tools/run_set.py:79-84) and to plan.json/prompts.json in OUT. No LLM value becomes a file path, command argument, URL or HTML. A malformed answer causes at worst a KeyError/TypeError in the operator's own run.

local_checks.invariant: Assembled model context contains no credentials or other principals' data that model output could disclose
local_checks.result: Context = fixed prompt text, prior LLM answers about the same photo set, and image URLs of the same family's photos (photo_url -> kie_compare.upload). judge.py:143-145 sends a frame grid of the operator's own clip. The Authorization header carries the placeholder 'proxy-injected'; the real key is added by the proxy and is never in the model input. Model output only goes back to the same provider. vision-cache.json is written and read only in the operator's OUT dir.

local_checks.invariant: Output file paths written by db_photos.py must not be derived from DB-controlled values (no path traversal via id/k).
local_checks.result: Covered: dst is os.path.join(out, f"{i:02d}.jpg") using the enumeration index only (db_photos.py:26); chunk id/k are used only as dict keys (lines 18, 21, 27). Malformed n/k only raise KeyError/StopIteration (crash, operator-local). No traversal.

local_checks.invariant: Values from the shared Artifact DB (session/photos items[].subject.x/y) must be validated as numbers or shell-quoted before being printed into the run_set.py argument line that the operator pastes into a shell command.
local_checks.result: Not enforced: db_photos.py:28-29 interpolates s['x'] and s['y'] verbatim into the argument string and line 32 prints them space-joined with no shlex.quote or numeric check. The page only writes numbers (transition-test.html:219), but the DB stores whatever any writer sets (savePhotos at :177 copies subject as-is; no schema). run_set.py/align_faces.py only float() the value after the shell has already parsed the line (run_set.py:52-54, align_faces.py:52-53). PROJECT_STATE.md:327 and :489 document the workflow as pasting the printed <args> into `python3 tools/run_set.py OUT <args> --max-credits ...` run in the operator's Bash session. Whether a lower-trust principal can write the DB, and whether the operator transcribes literally, are outside source.
Independent re-read confirmed the trace (db_photos.py:28-29,32; PROJECT_STATE.md:327,489-490); decision needs_validation: DB write access and literal paste are outside source.

surface: Provider task results (recordInfo resultJson.resultUrls, song URLs)
boundary: urllib.request.urlretrieve and ffmpeg/OpenCV processing of downloaded media

excluded_blocks.reason: no package manifest, lockfile, CI or release config in the repository
no HTTP server or auth protocol implemented in source

local_checks.invariant: Provider-supplied result URLs are restricted to https on the expected result host before urllib fetches them into the output directory
local_checks.result: No control exists. resultJson.resultUrls[0] (and audio_url / resultUrls for songs) goes straight to urllib.request.urlretrieve in four places: tools/run_set.py:126-129, tools/kie_compare.py:127-132, tools/kie_watch.py:41-43 and tools/make_song.py:61-69. CPython's urlretrieve goes through urlopen's default handlers, which include file:, ftp:, data: and http(s) to any host. With a filename argument, a file: URL is copied from local disk.

local_checks.invariant: Data fetched from a provider URL is not re-sent to a third party unless it is the expected generated clip
local_checks.result: In run_set the downloaded file (cp['file']) is decoded by judge.code_checks via cv2.VideoCapture (tools/judge.py:23). Its frames are put in a grid (judge.py:143) and uploaded to KIE through AP.vision -> photo_url -> kie_compare.upload (tools/auto_plan.py:29-34, 68; tools/kie_compare.py:37-50). They are also concatenated into OUT/video.mp4 (tools/run_set.py:186-203). Whether OpenCV decodes the copied file, and whether a provider response can carry such a URL, cannot be observed without execution or provider behavior.

local_checks.invariant: ffmpeg concat list built from downloaded files cannot be steered by provider data
local_checks.result: The concat list (tools/run_set.py:199-202) holds only paths built by the code under OUT/parts/NN.mp4, which are re-encoded with libx264 (line 186-188) before concat. Provider data never controls the path text. The downloaded file is passed as ffmpeg -i <local path> with content probing; demuxer-level behavior depends on the toolchain and was not executed.
Independent re-read confirmed the urlretrieve sinks and the judge/upload chain; decision needs_validation: requires a malicious provider response and a sandboxed harness.

local_checks.invariant: DB-sourced strings (session/photos items, results/*, ratings/*) must reach the DOM only as text nodes or non-executing attribute values; attribute names and event handlers must come from code.
local_checks.result: Holds: el() (lines 164-172) uses createElement, setAttribute with code-chosen attribute names, and append() of strings (text nodes); the 'on' key is only passed from code literals. DB values reach text (r.label/r.model/r.error/facts/r.res, lines 308-313), img src (186, 212, 293-294) and video src (311). No innerHTML/outerHTML/document.write/eval/setTimeout-string/href or iframe sink exists in the file. img/video src with a javascript: URL does not execute. markPt x/y only reach style.left/top after numeric multiplication (208).

local_checks.invariant: DB-controlled id/name attributes must not clobber globals or config used by security-relevant code.
local_checks.result: Holds: the only DB-influenced id is textarea id 'note-' + r.key (305); the fixed hyphenated prefix cannot shadow claude, db, assets or any identifier the script reads, and the script keeps its state in closure variables, not window globals.

local_checks.invariant: DB-controlled keys must not reach a recursive write that pollutes Object.prototype with a reachable gadget.
local_checks.result: Holds: object spreads of DB data ({...x}, {...d.data()}, lines 331, 335-336) use CreateDataProperty and do not set prototypes; ratings[d.id] with d.id '__proto__' only changes the prototype of the local ratings object (no global pollution, no security gadget). byT[r.from] with r.from '__proto__' makes .push throw (line 289), so results rendering fails: a writer-caused render error, not injection (see hardening).
